thread:
Sara_Sales: FYI SealVault reached out — they want BYO-HSM integration and want Redwood oncall during cutover. Can we confirm ops support, runbook ownership, and rough cost split? cc @Alex_SE
Alex_SE: Quick clarifying q: is this customer-managed CMK in their HSM or are we proxying keys? Paul, can you confirm the handshake flow?
Paul_SealVault: Confirmed: keys live in our AWS CloudHSM (customer account). We'll expose a TLS-mutual key-proxy endpoint that Redwood will call. No key material should ever be exported. We need dual-custody for prod keys and a 02:00-05:00 UTC rotation window.
Mike_Infra: mTLS + private peering needed. We'll require IP allowlist + client cert CN and cert thumbprint. Note: every HSM roundtrip adds ~30–50ms; for signing-heavy flows that matters.
Alex_SE: We can do prefix/KV caching for generation flows, but signing ops can't be cached. For latency-sensitive paths recommend a dedicated proxy (or dedicated capacity) to reduce variance.
Jess_Security: For the security questionnaire: does Redwood persist customer key material anywhere? Also need audit log retention options and HSM attestation docs.
Alex_SE: Redwood stores only key references; we never persist CMK material. Envelope DEKs live ephemeral in the data plane. We'll include a short explainer in the SOW.
Paul_SealVault: SealVault's legal requires explicit no-export clause and 5-year audit log retention. Also need proof of HSM attestation and CloudHSM audit report prior to cutover.
Sara_Sales: Pricing ask from the customer: how do we bill HSM-backed operations during POC vs prod? Can we propose a timeboxed oncall/standby fee for cutover + request-based billing afterwards?
Mike_Infra: Suggested: POC cutover package = 8h standby + 24h monitoring + 2 SE-led dry runs. Flat fee (TBD). Production: reserved throughput (dedicated capacity) + per-10k HSM ops egress fee.
Alex_SE: Also need to schedule penetration test. SealVault wants their vendor to run tests in the week before cutover. Who owns coordination and providing endpoint inventory?
Jess_Security: Security will coordinate pen-test. We'll need to provide an agreed test plan, list of endpoints (IP + port), and test blackout windows. Also supply SOC2 and HSM attestation links.
Paul_SealVault: Tentative dates: pen-test week Apr 1, cutover Apr 12 02:00-06:00 UTC. Can Redwood commit SE + infra oncall for cutover window?
Sara_Sales: Tentatively yes if we can lock SE + infra. Alex — can you produce runbook + escalation matrix and confirm rollback plan?
Alex_SE: On it. Runbook will include: pre-cutover checks, cert/thumbprint exchange, health probes, smoke tests, rollout steps, rollback steps. Rollback requirement: ability to flip back to Redwood-managed keys within 30 minutes.
Mike_Infra: Rollback supported if cache/DEK replication is tested. Need a staging failover run to validate timeline.
Jess_Security: Rotation policy question: SealVault requests 90-day CMK rotation with versioning. Can we support automatic rewrap of DEKs when CMK rotates, or is that manual?
Alex_SE: We don't hold CMKs; we perform envelope wrapping. We provide tooling to rewrap DEKs when the CMK rotates — will document manual steps and automation options in runbook.
Paul_SealVault: Legal needs a KMS addendum for SOC2. Sara, can you loop legal? Also need commitment on breach notification (48h) and quarterly incident drills.
Sara_Sales: Looping in Linda from legal. @Linda_Legal please review required clauses and flag anything that must be in SOW.
Linda_Legal: On it. Please add clauses for no-key-export, breach notification within 48 hours, quarterly incident exercises, and indemnity limits for key compromise.
Alex_SE: Uploaded initial runbook draft: https://redwood.app/drive/runs/sealvault-cutover-runbook. It includes sample network ACLs and the rollback script. Sample allowlist snippet:
```
ALLOWLIST:
- 3.34.12.55/32  # Redwood SE primary
- 3.34.12.56/32  # Redwood failover
CERT_CN: redwood-client.sealvault.example.com
```
Paul_SealVault: Thanks. Can we get a cost estimate and final SOW by EOD Thursday? The customer signoff depends on that.
Sara_Sales: I'll assemble draft SOW and PO. Mike/Jess/Alex — please comment on hours and deliverables by EOD tomorrow so I can include accurate costs.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance Apr 3 00:00-02:00 UTC may affect staging env used for pen-test.
Alex_SE: Noted. I'll add blackout windows to runbook and set up a dry-run in staging next Tue.
Paul_SealVault: Great — appreciate the fast turnaround. We'll also provide the pen-test vendor contact this afternoon.
Sara_Sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post the SOW link when ready and tag approvers.
